part.name: Multi-block heated toolhead / manifold assembly (9 solids)
part.description: Assembly-like STEP containing five main machined blocks, one central cylindrical heatbreak/stand-off, and three nozzle/fastener-like threaded parts. Geometry suggests a heated/fluid/thermal manifold with clamping interfaces and mounting holes; includes a finned heat-sink style block on the +X side and a mirrored/paired block set on the -X side with multi-bore top faces.
part.symmetry_note: Overall layout is approximately symmetric about the X=0 plane for the lower/nozzle region (paired left/right subassemblies), but not perfectly symmetric due to the +X finned block and differing clamp blocks.

Section.name: Left multi-bore block (-X upper block)
features included: Top multi-bore interface (multiple large vertical counterbored holes)
Flat mounting faces (X-, X+, Y0, Z0, Zmax)
Section.function intent: Provide a rigid manifold/reservoir body with multiple vertical bores for inserts/fasteners and side ports for attachment to adjacent clamp/adapter blocks.
Section.physical behavior: Acts as a stiff load-spreading block; flat faces provide datum references; bores locate and clamp mating components via bolts/threads; chamfers reduce stress concentrations and aid assembly.
Section.geometry: Rectangular prismatic block with multiple vertical cylindrical cavities from the top face and side holes; includes angled/chamfered external faces near the lower perimeter.
Section.location: Upper left region of assembly, negative X, Y near 0, Z from 0 to ~25.

Section.function intent: Provide a compact coupling/manifold between the upper blocks and the lower heater/nozzle region; serve as a datum and distribution body for clamped cylindrical elements.
Section.physical behavior: Stiff block provides alignment via bores; distributes clamp load into adjacent blocks; maintains positional stability under thermal/mechanical loads.
Section.geometry: Block-like prismatic body with multiple top openings and internal cylindrical features; relatively small compared to heatsink/upper blocks.

Section.name: Right finned heatsink block (+X upper block)
features included: Large planar datum faces (Z0, Zmax, X min/max, Y0)
Section.function intent: Increase surface area for heat dissipation and provide a rigid mount for bolted interfaces on the +X side.
Section.physical behavior: Fins increase convective area; thick core carries bolt preload and prevents warping; planar faces act as mounting datums; internal bores provide fastener clearance/threads.
Section.geometry: Rectangular block with a large fin field (many repeated planar steps) on one side; multiple large through/counterbored holes and smaller mounting holes.
Section.location: Upper right region, x≈24..56, y≈-18..0, z≈0..30.

Section.name: Clamp / adapter blocks (mid-size grey blocks)
features included: Split-clamp semicircular cutouts for cylindrical parts
Through holes / tapped holes for clamp screws
Section.function intent: Clamp and locate cylindrical components (heatbreak/tube) and bridge between the upper blocks and the lower heater/nozzle bracket.
Section.physical behavior: Clamp halves convert screw preload into radial compression; provides constrained DOF (translation/rotation) for the cylinder; distributes stress into block faces and avoids localized yielding by using counterbored seats.
Section.geometry: One or more rectangular prismatic blocks with a circular/semicircular slot, additional round bores, and small side holes; includes chamfers on corners.
Section.location: Mid assembly around y≈-34..-46 and x≈24.5..48.5 (and likely matching smaller blocks near center).

Section.function intent: Provide the main structural carriage for the lower hot-end/nozzle region; position and support nozzle/fastener solids and provide mounting reference planes.
Section.physical behavior: Plate-like component spreads load to mounts; pockets provide clearance and reduce mass; bores locate nozzle/fastener bodies; angled faces ease insertion and reduce stress risers.
